ideas.idea: Bigfoot is real: read the Skunk Ape flyer (Skeeter's bar in Hamlet), call Kirk, search the swamp at night, find three tree effigies, reach Mr. Mangrove; twist: he was a man (Harry Sherrick) who went missing ten years ago, changed by the swamp spores; shoot him for $10,000 or spare him
ideas.note: Left out: the exact sighting spot (east vs south of Cottonmouth Lake), the flyer reward amount, Harry Sherrick's name in the voice-over, and how the other endings play out (guides word them differently).
